hero.title: Home Assistant AI Digest
hero.copy: Turn Home Assistant warnings, unavailable entities, stale sensors, and delivery failures into a private daily briefing you can act on.
hero.privacy: Secrets are sent only to the local backend and displayed as masks after validation.

onboarding.title: Guided onboarding
onboarding.schedulePrivacyNotice: For now we will use a daily digest at 08:00 Europe/Madrid with balanced privacy. You can change schedule and data scope when settings persistence is available.
onboarding.missingSetupToken: The setup assistant bootstrap key is missing. Provide it through a private channel before completing first run.

errors.haUrl: Enter a valid Home Assistant URL.

manualDigest.title: Manual digest
manualDigest.copy: Manual digests will be available after settings and history are persisted.

loading.title: Loading history
loading.copy: Looking for saved digests in the local backend.

empty.title: No digests yet
empty.copy: After you run the first digest, it will appear here with its analyzed window and delivery status.

error.title: History could not be loaded
error.copy: Check that the session is still active and try again.

unavailable.title: History waiting for connection
unavailable.copy: History will load after the frontend has a secure backend session.

notes.title: Operator notes
notes.copy: Add manual context so future digests explain what was happening at home.

ignoredWarnings.title: Ignored warnings
ignoredWarnings.copy: Silence known entities or messages so the digest stays focused on actionable work.

telegramTest.title: Telegram test-send
telegramTest.copy: Send a short message to the saved channel without exposing the token in the browser.
telegramTest.missingCopy: Save a Telegram channel during first run before testing delivery.

settings.title: Privacy and retention
settings.copy: Edit safe settings already returned by the local backend. Secrets stay referenced and masked.

mutationErrors.removeIgnore: The ignored warning could not be removed. Try again.
mutationErrors.settings: Settings could not be saved. Try again.
